Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left-turn lane at a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas, when the
collision occurred during a left turn. Driver 2 was proceeding southbonud and struck the left side of Driver 1's vehicle.
A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was present during the impact. Driver 1
reported neck and back strain and stated that pain began shortly after the collision. Responding officers observed
that the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the reported angle and direction of impact, and no earlier damage
to Driver 1's vehicle was known or reported. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the details provided
by the drivers, though no independent witnesses came forward. Both drivers and the Passenger were interviewed,
and their accounts of the vehicle positions were consistent with one another. The driver of Driver 1's vehicle is listed
as a named insured on the applicable policy. At this time it is not clear whether the reported injuries resulted from this
collision, and the matter has been referred for further medical review.
